profile.owner: ServiceTitan (NASDAQ: TTAN); FieldRoutes brands itself 'a ServiceTitan company'. Formed in 2021 when PestRoutes and Lobster Marketing rebranded as FieldRoutes.
profile.target_customers: Pest control and lawn care operators from small business to enterprise, with focus on local and regional pest companies. Showcases large door-to-door operators (Aptive, Fox, Aruza). Claims 1,700+ companies.
profile.pricing: Not published. Growth and Corporate tiers both say Request Pricing, with the monthly subscription based on active customer count. G2 lists a start of $350 per month per 1,000 active customers, and Capterra lists the same $350 start; older listings say $199. One 2026 reviewer cites about $364/month for under 500 customers. Marketing Pro and Fleet Pro are add-ons with no published prices, and reviewers report per-message SMS fees and payment-processing lock-in.
profile.deployment: Cloud (web-based Operations Suite) plus native iOS and Android apps.
profile.mobile_app: FieldRoutes App (FieldRoutes Mobile), one app for technicians and sales reps that replaced the PestRoutes Tech and PestRoutes Sales apps; iOS and Android; customer-only. Rated 3.3 from 25 ratings on the US App Store (October 2026).
integrations: QuickBooks Online (Desktop per a third-party comparison)
Open API (Premium API listed on pricing page)
strengths: Strong routing and scheduling: map-based drag and drop, skill-based assignment, batch route optimization across thousands of stops.
Unified mobile app for technicians and door-to-door sales, with territories, no-knock zones, contracts, signatures and field payments.
Deep termite support: Sentricon hub with Corteva reporting, NPMA-33 forms and California Branch 3 WDO reporting.
Integrated payments with AutoPay, collections reminders and Trigger Rules automation for texts, emails and voice reminders.
Scales to multi-branch enterprise operators with open API and ServiceTitan backing and add-on products.
weaknesses: Recurring bugs, updates that break or move features, and slow ticket resolution are frequent review complaints.
Price is high for small companies, with extra charges for SMS, card processing and some contract changes.
Steep learning curve, especially for office and billing tasks, with thin training material for new users.
QuickBooks sync setup issues and no built-in general ledger; invoice and report customization is limited.
Key extras (marketing automation, fleet GPS, AI dash cams) are separate ServiceTitan Pro products.
profile.wisconsin_notes: Kwik Kill Pest Control of Madison, Wisconsin, a ServSuite user since 2013, moved to FieldRoutes by the end of March 2023, per a FieldRoutes case study published Oct 2023; whether it still runs FieldRoutes in 2026 is unverified. No Wisconsin-specific compliance (ATCP 29, landscape registry notice) found. Only named state compliance is California Branch 3 WDO reporting and NPMA-33.

features.notes: Pest CRM with lead management and pipeline visibility from first contact to signed contract.
Dashboard tracks cost per lead and customer acquisition cost; close rate or revenue by lead source not documented.
Quotes built in the office and mobile app, including home diagrams for termite and WDO quotes. Tiered good, better, best options not confirmed.
Contracts signed in the mobile app with inline signatures; digital agreements can also be sent by email or SMS.
Mobile app supports door-to-door sales: territories, no-knock zones, zip code territory limits, leaderboards, sign-up and payment at the door.
Sales Cookie integration calculates commissions from FieldRoutes data; it states FieldRoutes lacks native quotas, splits and payout schedules.
ServiceTitan Marketing Pro runs email and direct mail campaigns (unsold estimates, win-back, upsell). Core Trigger Rules send renewal reminders.
Cancellation reason codes and save workflows not documented. A Revenue Retention churn tool was announced in Oct 2026 as upcoming.
Multi-unit properties (apartments, retail, townhomes) can be linked under one account with consolidated invoicing.
Phone system integration through marketplace partner Scorpion. No native click to call or call recording documented.
Recurring subscriptions generate ongoing service; individual and bulk scheduling for ongoing contracts. Cadence options not detailed publicly.
Lawn rounds are modeled as subscriptions rather than native programs and rounds, per a third-party comparison.
Bundled service plans and measurement-based pricing reported; a central tiered price book is not documented.
No FieldRoutes documentation found for bulk price increases (ServiceTitan core lists it, but that is a different product).
Contract terms exist as account fields with access controls; auto-renewal and early cancellation fees not documented.
Manages termite warranties and renewals; Sentricon renewals report with anniversary filters; automated renewal reminders.
No public documentation of re-service or callback tracking with cost capture.
Fill Routes and bulk scheduling place due services from subscriptions onto optimized routes automatically.
Drag and drop scheduling with a map view schedule for drawing or dragging appointments onto routes.
Instant and batch route optimization across many routes, factoring drive time and fuel.
Routes organized by technician skillset, e.g. termite-qualified techs for termite inspections; license validity checks are not documented.
Customer portal lets customers self-schedule or request appointments online.
GPS vehicle tracking, geofencing and telematics via ServiceTitan Fleet Pro, sold as a separate product.
Bulk scheduling and batch optimization documented; moving many existing appointments at once (e.g. weather) not confirmed.
FieldRoutes App on iOS and Android, available only to subscribers; App Store rating 3.3 from 25 ratings.

Release notes cite offline photo queuing, offline appointment edits, reliability fixes and offline card payments that stay pending (Oct 2026). Full offline depth is undocumented, and an Oct 2026 App Store review says reports were wiped by auto-sync.
Technicians document chemical usage in the mobile app; products support linear footage and default products per equipment.
Up to 100 photos per appointment, voice-to-text notes and inline customer signatures.
Equipment can be scanned with a Bluetooth barcode scanner from the appointment workflow.
Card payments in the app, including door-to-door payment workflow. Check and cash handling not confirmed.
Review sites list timesheet management, but no vendor page documents a mobile time clock.
Techs see product availability on their route with low-supply warnings; updating vehicle stock from the device not documented.
Chemical usage captured on visits feeds chemical tracking and state chemical reports pulled by office staff.
Product list exists, but EPA registration numbers, label and SDS storage are not documented for FieldRoutes.
Scheduling considers technician certifications and the API exposes licenses; license expiry alerts not documented.
California Branch 3 WDO reporting, paperless NPMA-33 forms and state chemical reports.
Trigger Rules automate customer messages, but pesticide pre- or post-application notices are not documented.
No public information on restricted-use pesticide limits or RUP record fields.
Inventory for pesticides with route-level stock and capacity; warehouse purchasing and transfers not documented.
No mention of Wisconsin, ATCP 29 or landscape registry notice. Only California and NPMA-33 are named.
Equipment such as bait stations tracked per property with product associations and Bluetooth barcode scanning.
Structures can be defined in the app and reviews list property layouts; device floor plan maps not confirmed.
Commercial trend reporting on pest activity, included in both pricing tiers.
Vendor cites audit-ready documentation for state and federal compliance; AIB, SQF or BRC support not named.
Branded portal with property notifications and multi-property trend reports; maps, labels and SDS in portal not confirmed.
Techs report pest-conducive conditions with recommendations and status alerts; customer sighting logs not documented.
Consolidates multiple units onto one invoice; PO numbers and net terms not mentioned.
Sentricon bait hub, WDO and NPMA-33 inspection reports, and termite home diagrams in the mobile app.
No public documentation of wildlife trapping or exclusion job workflows.
No public documentation of bed bug multi-visit jobs or prep checklists.
No vendor page describes seasonal mosquito or tick programs.
FieldRoutes Payments for card processing built in. ACH not explicitly mentioned on the payments page.
AutoPay with stored cards and automatic outreach to update expired cards; on by default for new door-to-door sign-ups.
Monthly budget plans and prepayment discounts documented; per-visit versus annual prepay for the same service not shown.
Tax-exempt status field exists; jurisdiction-based tax rates by service address not documented.
Collection tools, escalating automated payment reminders, collection stage filters. Late fees and service holds not confirmed.
Consolidated invoicing combines services from a period or multiple units into one master invoice.
No public documentation of prorated refunds or cancellation balance calculation.
Vendor positions QuickBooks sync for month-end accounting; no ledger, journals or financial statements described.
QuickBooks Online sync for end-of-month processing; reviewers report setup and auto-sync issues.
Vendor mentions other accounting systems without naming Sage, Xero or NetSuite.
Prepayments supported, but deferred revenue recognition is not documented.
No public documentation of labor and material job costing or margin per job.
Marketplace mentions an unnamed payroll and HR partner; production pay and payroll export not documented.
Customer portal to pay invoices, view payment history and appointments, set AutoPay and request service.

Vendor says automated appointment reminders go out by text message and phone call, and the app has an On my way action, extended to multi-service appointments in June 2026. Whether On my way sends a text is not stated; reviewers report per-message SMS fees.
Outbound SMS documented (with per-message fees); two-way office texting not confirmed.
Automated post-service rating requests with Google review link and NPS; LoyaltyLoop integration also available.
WDO reports can be emailed; a general post-visit report listing products applied is not documented.
Dashboards for active customers, owed payments, stops per route; reports on payment status and delinquencies.
Retention and churn analytics (Revenue Retention) announced Oct 2026 as upcoming, not yet confirmed available.
Mobile and dashboards show technician and sales rep performance and productivity, including stops per route.
Customizable dashboards and saved report filters; no full report builder. AI Command Center analytics is upcoming.
Multi-office operations, centralized or decentralized, with reporting compared across offices.
Permission-based dashboards and admin controls restricting which reps can view or edit sensitive fields.
Open API with developer docs; Premium API listed in both plans.
Implementation team imports and cleans historical data during a 2 to 3 month onboarding.
AI dash cams in Fleet Pro; AI Command Center analytics and AI sales coaching announced but not confirmed live.
No hosted website or embeddable lead form documented; Scorpion is a marketplace partner but its role is unclear.
Marketing Pro adds direct mail, including property-based postcards to prospects. Call tracking and SEO not documented.

extra_features.notes: Tracks Sentricon installs, service, inspections and renewals, with monthly reporting to Corteva Agriscience.
Event-based rules send customer texts, emails and voice messages and create internal alerts and tasks.
Route templates set chemical capacity, estimate daily product needs from past jobs and warn when supply runs low.
Built-in tool to calculate mix and dilution rates for products.
Zip code territories, no-knock zones, area sales stats and rep leaderboards for door-to-door teams.
Units in multi-unit properties scheduled by a set number or percentage per appointment.
Wisetack partner offers customer financing for larger jobs.

extra_features.feature: Fleet safety (AI dash cams, driver scorecards)
extra_features.notes: Fleet Pro add-on detects risky driving, scores drivers and supports insurance claims with video.
Announced Oct 2026 to fill same-day openings after cancellations; not yet confirmed available.
